title: High-Performance Quantum Frequency Conversion from Ultraviolet to Telecom Band
summary: Quantum frequency conversion (QFC) is essential for bridging the spectral gap between stationary qubits and low-loss optical communication channels. In this work, we demonstrate a short-wavelength-pumping QFC with the first-order quasi-phase matching period of 3.07 um on thin-film lithium niobate, converting ultraviolet photons to the telecom C-band.
